messages:
alex-swe: Hey team — planning to work remotely from my partner's flat in Lisbon for ~12 weeks (June 1 -> Aug 24). Couple questions before I submit the form: 1) Is WFH stipend prorated for a 12-week abroad stay? 2) Any Portuguese social security / tax registration risk for 12w? 3) Ill need to ship my MacBook and an external monitor  can we use company shipping vendor for both? 4) Anything re: benefits (healthcare continuity) I should worry about while abroad?

tara-peopleops: Hi Alex  short answers: stipend = prorated by calendar days for temporary moves under 90 days; 12w will be prorated. You must submit the Temporary Location form with exact dates + address. That triggers payroll/legal. For benefits: your core Redwood benefits remain active while on company payroll; confirm travel medical insurance if you need local coverage.

marta-legal: For Portugal: residency and tax residency are generally 183-day rules or habitual residence tests. 12 weeks (84 days) alone usually doesn't create tax residency, but if you do client-facing work or sign local contracts it can create presence risk. Also note the Non-Habitual Resident (NHR) regime is irrelevant for short stays. We'll run a quick PE/nexus check once the form is in.

ed-payroll: Payroll notes: confirm whether you want stipend paid in USD or EUR. We pay stipends through payroll and taxes per your home-country payroll setup; we typically do not gross-up for temporary overseas stays under 90 days. Equipment shipping: if you use company vendor, we'll provide temporary export docs to avoid import duties on return. If you ship external monitor (non-company asset), duties could apply.

logistics-bot: Shipping policy: use ShipOps (shipops@redwood.com). Company covers shipping for company-owned devices if vendor used. Insurance cap for transit: $2,000 per device. Personal items  not covered. Link: https://redwood.company/hr/shipping-policy

tara-peopleops: Quick checklist for your submission:
```
- Temporary Location form (dates, full address, reason)
- Device list (serials for company devices, indicate devices youll bring vs ship)
- Payroll currency preference (USD/EUR)
- Confirmation you'll remain on Redwood payroll and not engage local contracting
- Manager approval (please CC your manager)
- Travel medical insurance copy if staying in EU > 30 days
```

marta-legal: One more legal detail: please avoid signing any consulting or local gig agreements while abroad. If you plan to meet with customers in Lisbon, flag it on the form  in-person customer meetings can increase nexus risk.

alex-swe: Thanks all. Im bringing the monitor personally, will list it on the form as personal. Company MacBook (serial M1-XYZ987) should be shipped by vendor. I prefer stipend in USD. Ill CC my manager on the form and attach my travel insurance. Any reason to request a gross-up?

ed-payroll: Gross-up is unusual for temporary stays under 90 days; we only gross-up in rare circumstances (e.g., assignment mandated by company or if local law requires). We'll calculate the prorated stipend and show tax withholding impact once the form is processed.

logistics-bot: HR case created: HR-8842 "Temporary remote: Lisbon 2026-06-01 to 2026-08-24 (Alex)". Ticket assigned to people-ops/tara.

tara-peopleops: Thanks Alex  once you submit the form we'll run the payroll/legal scan and confirm shipping instructions and any documents needed for customs. Enjoy Lisbon :sun_with_face:
